about: CodeQL results reviewed and found not to be vulnerabilities, one entry per result. An entry matches the scan, the rule, the exact path and the text of the flagged line in the checkout, trimmed, so it follows code that moves and comes back for review when the line changes. The Security workflow fails on any result not listed here, and on any entry that no longer matches a result.

Compatibility verification of an existing Office VBA project password: MS-OVBA section 2.4.4.4 requires SHA-1(password bytes in PROJECTCODEPAGE followed by the stored four-byte key). XLIDE does not create a new password hash, store the entered password, or upgrade Office protection; changing the digest algorithm would prevent valid Office passwords from unlocking their projects. VBA project protection remains a legacy access restriction, not encryption of module source. The mandated weak digest is accepted only at this verifier.
